passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: My English teacher is kind, and she has a nice smile.
phrases.ko: 나의 영어 선생님은 친절하고, 좋은 미소가 있어요.

phrases.en: She likes to teach, and she teaches a new word.
phrases.ko: 선생님은 가르치는 것을 좋아하고, 새 단어를 가르쳐요.

phrases.en: She is patient when we try again.
phrases.ko: 우리가 다시 해 보면 선생님은 참을성이 있어요.

phrases.en: Our class is fun, and I learn a lot.
phrases.ko: 우리 수업은 재미있고, 나는 많이 배워요.

phrases.en: I like my teacher because she listens.
phrases.ko: 선생님은 잘 들어 주셔서 나는 선생님을 좋아해요.

phrases.en: She teaches English in a clear voice.
She smiles when our class tries hard.
phrases.ko: 우리 반이 열심히 하면 선생님이 미소를 지어요.

phrases.en: I want to learn because the class is fun.
A patient teacher helps a student feel brave.
phrases.ko: 참을성 있는 선생님은 학생이 용기를 내게 도와줘요.

phrases.en: I thank my teacher at the end of class.

full_passage_spoken: My English teacher is kind, and she has a nice smile. She likes to teach, and she teaches a new word. She is patient when we try again. Our class is fun, and I learn a lot. I like my teacher because she listens. She teaches English in a clear voice. Every new word is useful. She smiles when our class tries hard. I want to learn because the class is fun. A patient teacher helps a student feel brave. I thank my teacher at the end of class.
